bdgp-drosophila-1941.notes: Negatives are paired by BDGP directory (Drosophila/promoter/CDS and intron). dro-part.* and promoter_training_1842.fa are subsets of the 1,941 set and are acquired only.

bdgp-drosophila-1998.notes: Headers state 250 bp upstream and 50 bp downstream; the TSS base convention is unresolved.

bdgp-human.notes: Positives carry EPD identifiers; headers state 250 bp upstream and 50 bp downstream.

bhandari-human.notes: Window -700..+299 around the TSS (headers up_700 and 3-prime pad 300). Published negatives are synthetic shuffles and are not distributed.

bhandari-human-random-genomic.notes: Random human genomic sequences used by the authors only as external test negatives.

bhandari-nominal-plant.notes: Identity conflict: file name and publication say A. thaliana (araTha1), but every header carries mm10 coordinates. Organism is left blank on purpose.

bhandari-yeast.notes: Window -700..+299 around the TSS (headers up_700 and 3-prime pad 300). Published negatives are synthetic shuffles and are not distributed.
